visualCharacteristics.purpose: breadcrumb trail (Home, parent pages, current page) shown at the top of most content pages

contentPattern.structure: one cell with the trail: a list of links (or links in a paragraph); the last, unlinked item is the current page. Left empty, the trail is built from the URL path

reuseGuidance: Use for the page trail at the top of content pages. If the trail should always match the URL, leave it empty and let it build from the path.
